milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the cracked nether bricks and face toward them. The target is set to (6, 1, 6) which is the center of the structure containing the cracked_nether_bricks blocks. max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to visually identify the blocks, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking toward the structure.
